mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month MA), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.01 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
